targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
The D sites were initially cleared
of vegetation in an area of 1 ha, and then filled with allochthonous
soil compacted for drilling rigs placement. The measurement units
were placed in the portion of the drilling-platform that is not used
(0.7 ha in accordance with the legal regulations of environmental
authorities of the Province of Neuquén, Argentina). It was verified
that these sites did not record any events or signs of oil spills. Also,
according to the aforementioned regulations, the sites were aban-
doned after soil scarification, which involved creating furrows 15 cm
deep to promote natural revegetation (see Figure 2).
targeting_gate.rationale: Petroleum-platform shrubland rehabilitation, not agroforestry. Scarification followed by soil/vegetation comparison is implementation performance, not farm-tree siting.
